job.job_description:
Job Summary




We are looking for a highly skilled Python Automation Engineer with a strong background in AI-driven automation and Networking technologies. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in developing automation frameworks, network protocol validation, and integrating AI solutions to improve network operations and security.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Python-based automation frameworks and tools.
Automate network configuration, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting processes.
Develop AI/ML-enabled solutions for network analytics, anomaly detection, and operational efficiency.
Work closely with networking, security, and infrastructure teams to automate complex workflows.
Build and optimize APIs, scripts, and automation pipelines.
Troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking issues and implement automation solutions.
Integrate authentication and authorization systems with automated network environments.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design initiatives.
Create technical documentation and best practices for automation solutions.



Must-Have Skills

Strong programming experience in Python Automation.
Exposure to AI/ML concepts and AI-driven automation solutions.
Strong understanding of:
Layer 2 Networking
Layer 3 Networking
IEEE 802.1X Authentication
AAA (Authentication, Authorization & Accounting)
RADIUS Protocol
Experience with network automation tools, APIs, and scripting frameworks.
Knowledge of network troubleshooting and protocol analysis.

Good-to-Have Skills

VPN Client and VPN Server applications
IPv4 and IPv6 Networking
Active Directory (AD)
Azure Active Directory (Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID)
SAML Authentication
TACACS+ (Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus)
Experience with cloud networking and security technologies
Familiarity with Linux environments and DevOps practices

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
Experience in networking, security, or enterprise infrastructure domains.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder manag
